property: The bootstrap problem expands from link-local hardware-address-to-protocol-address discovery into an IP/UDP client-server bootstrap exchange capable of returning broader boot information and operating through gateways.

sources.locator: RFC 951, Comparison to RARP and Booting Through Gateways
sources.supports: BOOTP's explicit comparison with RARP and broader routed bootstrap design

negative_claims: This edge does not claim RFC 951 formally obsoletes RFC 903.
This edge does not establish source-code descent from a RARP implementation into a BOOTP implementation.
RARP and BOOTP could coexist in deployed systems.
open_questions: Recover contemporary migration documentation from diskless workstation environments.
Identify implementations that supported both RARP and BOOTP.
notes: A role/generalization edge rather than a formal standards revision.
